{{Quote|Spotted throughout Ragunna's streets, the Tubpups are lively Echoes that serve as faithful companions. Whether they are playing with children, carrying art supplies, or working as handy baskets, they bring joy and energy wherever they go.|—Rinascita Echo Fiesta}}
'''Tubpup''' is an open-world [[NPC]] and [[Common Echoes|Common Echo]], commonly located within Ragunna City.

By interacting with Tubpup allow players to ride in it.
